description.en:
Runs a story event script, ev<_evid>.nutb, to its end. It creates a fresh event context (subev_ctx) with room for 4 coroutines, loads the event script "data/script/event/ev" + _evid + ".nutb" into that context (CMND_LOAD_SCRIPT) and waits for it to load. It then runs the script's Event function as a coroutine, waking it up once per frame until it has finished, and clears the context at the end.
Each frame it also calls SYS_EVENT_STEP() and sysCamCtrlStep, which drives the camera-control helpers (CamCtrlInit, CamCtrlMoveTo...).
It is called by ie4_ev_sub_std.nut, the standard event script: its Main function picks the runner from the event type set by SetupParam (4 = CallKiznaxEvent, 5 = CallShopEvent, 9 = CallMasterAvatar, anything else = CallEvent).
Event number, appended to "ev" to build the file name (e.g. 42010200 for ev42010200.nutb).

examples.case: The standard event script falling back to CallEvent (real code, from ie4_ev_sub_std.nut)
